title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 31
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 31: the people tear down the idols, Hezekiah organizes the priests and Levites, and the tithes are brought in heaps.

questions.text: When all this was finished, what did all Israel who were present do in the cities of Judah?
questions.explanation: They went out to the cities of Judah and broke the pillars in pieces, cut down the Asherah poles, and broke down the high places and the altars.

answers.text: They rebuilt the broken walls of all the cities
They broke down the pillars, Asherah poles and high places
They set up new altars on every high hill
They counted all the fighting men of Judah

questions.text: What did Hezekiah appoint the king's portion of his possessions for?
questions.explanation: He appointed the king's portion of his possessions for the burnt offerings: morning and evening, and for the Sabbaths, new moons, and set feasts.

answers.text: Sending gifts to the king of Assyria

questions.text: Whom did Hezekiah command to give the portion of the priests and the Levites?
questions.explanation: He commanded the people who lived in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, so that they might give themselves to Yahweh's law.

answers.text: The people who lived in Jerusalem
The foreigners living in the land

questions.text: In which month did they begin to lay the foundation of the heaps?
questions.explanation: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and they finished them in the seventh month.

questions.text: What did Hezekiah and the princes do when they came and saw the heaps?
questions.explanation: When Hezekiah and the princes saw the heaps, they blessed Yahweh and his people Israel.

answers.text: They blessed Yahweh and his people Israel
They rebuked the priests for waste
They ordered the heaps to be sold
They took the heaps to the king's house

questions.text: Who answered Hezekiah when he asked about the heaps?
questions.explanation: Azariah the chief priest, of the house of Zadok, answered him that they had eaten, had enough, and had plenty left over.

answers.text: Kore the gatekeeper at the east gate
Azariah the chief priest, of the house of Zadok

questions.text: What did Hezekiah command them to prepare in Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah commanded them to prepare rooms in Yahweh's house, and they prepared them.

questions.text: Who was ruler over the offerings, the tithes, and the dedicated things?
questions.explanation: They brought in the offerings, the tithes, and the dedicated things faithfully, and Conaniah the Levite was ruler over them, with Shimei his brother second.

questions.text: At which gate was Kore the son of Imnah the gatekeeper?
questions.explanation: Kore the son of Imnah the Levite was the gatekeeper at the east gate and was over the free will offerings of God.

questions.text: How did Hezekiah do every work he began in the service of God's house?
questions.explanation: In every work that he began in the service of God's house, in the law, and in the commandments, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.

answers.text: Slowly, and only after many warnings
In secret, out of fear of his enemies
With all his heart, and he prospered
Without asking the priests or Levites
